limitations: Flow-feature records characterize captured IoMT network traffic, not patient signals or clinical priority.
AVG is a flow-feature average packet size; it is mapped approximately to UDP payload bytes by subtracting IPv4 and UDP headers.
The profile shapes synthetic iperf packet size only; it does not replay captured packets or set clinical class rates.
The benign test split is sampled for inventory/reproducibility only and is not used to derive the workload profile.
selection: uniform reservoir sample over all rows; training split only
